sql: ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN image TEXT;

sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS potential_client_field_def (id_field_def INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, id_enterprise INTEGER, co_field TEXT, na_label TEXT, co_field_type TEXT, bl_required INTEGER, nu_order INTEGER, bl_active INTEGER);
